mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.2 percentage point decline in unemployment rate over three months signals labor market tightening, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE falls > 0.2pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signal robust housing and consumer demand recovery, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS increase by > 0.5% from previous month.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100.5) combined with rising unemployment (UNRATE > 6.5%) signals economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.5 AND UNRATE > 6.5.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above its 5-year average signals strong consumer demand, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS is above its 5-year average.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% annualized signals inflationary pressure, prompting Federal Reserve policy tightening and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% (annualized).

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market conditions (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly and UNRATE < 5.5%) signal robust job creation and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and UNRATE < 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100.5) combined with rising unemployment (UNRATE > 6.5%) signals economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.5 AND UNRATE > 6.5.
